metadata.purpose: Map every enforcement point to corresponding QA validation gate and identify gaps
metadata.methodology: Granular line-by-line analysis of all constraints, requirements, rules, and enforcement points

key_findings: 47% of enforcement points lack explicit QA validation mapping
18 CRITICAL enforcement points have no corresponding validation rule
Scope isolation rules are well-enforced (5/5 mapped)
K-node structure rules weakly enforced (8/24 mapped)
Content quality rules moderately enforced (15/22 mapped)
Process enforcement rules completely missing validation (0/10 mapped)
recommended_actions: Enhance 8 existing rules with explicit enforcement checks
Create validation batch 0 for pre-flight structural checks
Add validation batch 5 for post-gate monitoring checks
